generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can satisfy code, test, and document gates while a linked canonical acceptance tracker remains stale, leaving an implicit blocker outside the repository diff.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat parent, release, roadmap, or milestone checklists as administrative prose instead of mutable contract state that must be re-read after final evidence.

reusable_control.procedure: Re-fetch each linked canonical tracker after final evidence, synchronize evidence-backed items, keep only genuinely future or self-referential gates explicitly open, and reject implicit stale state.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Delivery must include mutable linked trackers in the input fingerprint and synchronize evidence-backed canonical checklist state before handoff.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independent audit must re-fetch linked canonical trackers and reject stale evidence-backed items or implicit pending state instead of trusting pull-request narrative.

transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic contract test requires completed evidence-backed items while preserving an explicit self-referential final gate.
Synthetic auditor contract rejects stale canonical checklist state and requires current remote observation.
